eyebrow.zh: 工具选择 · 导出 trace 的本地对照

headline.zh:
让每次工具选择
都有结果可对照
headline.en:
Compare tool choices.
See the outcome.

sub.zh: repick 把两次编码 Agent 的导出 trace 按任务对齐，比较工具选择、解决状态与记录耗时。
sub.en: repick aligns exported coding-agent traces by task to compare tool choices, resolution status and recorded duration.

caption.zh: 两次运行 · 按任务对照

body.zh: 按规范化后的任务描述配对两次运行，先确认结果是否可比，再看工具选择有什么不同。
body.en: Pair runs by normalized task descriptions, then inspect how the recorded choices differ.

body.zh: 工具汇总给出方向，--verbose 的逐任务表保留解决状态与耗时差异，便于回到原始记录核对。
body.en: Use the tool summary to orient your review, then inspect resolution and duration differences with --verbose.

body.zh: 每次运行以 JSONL 保存在本地。报告也是 Markdown，便于复制到 issue 或评审讨论中。
body.en: Each run stays in a local JSONL file. Reports are Markdown, ready to copy into an issue or review.

title.zh:
换了工具组合，
结果为何不同。
title.en:
A different tool set.
A result worth inspecting.

body.zh: 整次任务的成功与否还不足以解释差别。repick 把已经导出的工具事件整理到相同子任务下，比较先选了什么、是否解决、耗时多少。你得到一份可继续调查的对照报告。
body.en: The success of a whole run does not explain every difference. repick groups exported tool events under matching subtasks so you can inspect the first choice, resolution status and duration in a report.

body.zh: 以输入顺序中的第一条决策代表任务的工具选择，聚合该任务的各步结果，再比较两次运行。图中是自带合成 trace 的输入数值，不是实时 Agent 测量。
body.en: The first recorded decision represents the task’s tool choice. Step outcomes are aggregated before comparison. The figure uses values from supplied synthetic traces, not live agent measurements.

alt.zh: 三个配对任务的工具选择、解决状态和示例耗时差异。
alt.en: Tool choices, resolution status and fixture duration differences for three matched tasks.

title.zh: 两种输入，一份可比较记录

body.zh: 导入 adapter 统一字段，ToolDecision 保留选择及结果，JSONL ledger 保存每次运行；A/B 引擎读取记录并生成报告。
body.en: Ingest adapters normalize fields into ToolDecision records. A local JSONL ledger stores each run; the A/B engine reads the records and renders a report.

alt.zh: repick 的 adapter、ToolDecision、JSONL ledger 和 A/B 引擎。
alt.en: repick adapters, ToolDecision records, the JSONL ledger and A/B engine.

title.zh: 接入导出格式，带走本地报告
title.en: Bring exported traces, keep local reports

body.zh: v0.1.0 提供 Claude 格式与 Codex 格式的 JSONL adapter、标准输入、工具汇总和逐任务表。它们使用本项目的 schema，不是实时 Agent 连接。
body.en: v0.1.0 provides Claude-format and Codex-format JSONL adapters, standard input, tool summaries and task tables. They use this project’s schemas rather than live agent connections.

alt.zh: 已实现的输入格式、标准输入、本地保存和报告输出。
alt.en: Implemented input formats, standard input, local storage and report outputs.

body.zh: task_sig 规范化大小写、空白和标点，不识别语义。不同措辞不会自动匹配。secs 和 duration_ms 会统一为秒，但 token 字段的统计口径仍需由采集方统一。
body.en: task_sig normalizes case, whitespace and punctuation, not meaning. Different wording does not automatically match. Durations are converted to seconds; token definitions must be aligned by the trace producer.

body.zh: 只给共享 task_sig 判定胜负；只有一侧解决则该侧胜，两侧解决才比较耗时，5% 内视为平局。未配对任务可能仍在各自工具汇总中；用逐任务表核对。
body.en: Only shared task signatures receive verdicts. A sole resolved side wins; when both resolve, duration decides with a 5% tie band. Unmatched tasks may still appear in tool summaries, so inspect the task table.

title.zh: 把实验保存在不同 run 中

body.zh: 无需配置文件或 API key。ledger 位于当前目录的 .repick/<runId>.jsonl；record 使用追加写入，再做一次实验时应选择新的 run ID。
body.en: No configuration file or API key is required. The ledger lives at .repick/<runId>.jsonl under the current directory. record appends, so use a new run ID for another experiment.

title.zh: 导入两份 trace，得到真实 CLI 报告
title.en: Import two traces and inspect the CLI report

note.zh: 以下输出来自 v0.1.0 的本地执行。两份输入各有 3 条合成决策；耗时和 token 为输入值，不是工具性能测量。页面展示保存的输出，不在浏览器中运行 Agent。
note.en: These outputs come from a local v0.1.0 execution. Each input contains three synthetic decisions; duration and token values are fixture data, not tool-performance measurements. This page presents saved output and does not run an agent in your browser.

body.zh: Claude 格式示例导入为 run-A，产生 3 条 ToolDecision，并写入本地 ledger。
body.en: The Claude-format example becomes run-A with three ToolDecision records in the local ledger.

steps.command: bun src/cli.ts record run-A --agent claude --trace examples/claude-code-trace.jsonl

body.zh: Codex 格式示例导入为 run-B，产生 3 条 ToolDecision。两次运行中的任务随后可供比较。
body.en: The Codex-format example becomes run-B with three ToolDecision records. The two runs are now available for task comparison.

steps.command: bun src/cli.ts record run-B --agent codex --trace examples/codex-trace.jsonl

body.zh: 工具表把每个 run 的任务归到首先使用的工具名下。本例输出 grep 的建议文字，不会自动禁用它。
body.en: The tool table groups each run’s tasks by the first tool chosen. This example emits a suggestion about grep; it does not disable the tool.

steps.output:
repick ab — run-A vs run-B

| tool | run | picks | resolved | avg-secs | tokens | verdict | retune hint |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| grep | run-A | 3 | 2 | 24.3 | 3320 | loser | block grep (lost 3 tasks) |
| lsp-symbol | run-B | 2 | 2 | 7.5 | 840 | winner | — |
| ripgrep | run-B | 1 | 1 | 7 | 360 | winner | — |

Losing tool: grep (run-A) — block grep (lost 3 tasks)

body.zh: 逐任务表显示 find-dead-code、refactor-auth-module 和 rename-symbol-everywhere 的差异，三个判定均为 candidate-wins。
body.en: The task table shows differences for find-dead-code, refactor-auth-module and rename-symbol-everywhere, each with a candidate-wins verdict.

steps.output:
repick ab — run-A vs run-B

| tool | run | picks | resolved | avg-secs | tokens | verdict | retune hint |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| grep | run-A | 3 | 2 | 24.3 | 3320 | loser | block grep (lost 3 tasks) |
| lsp-symbol | run-B | 2 | 2 | 7.5 | 840 | winner | — |
| ripgrep | run-B | 1 | 1 | 7 | 360 | winner | — |

Losing tool: grep (run-A) — block grep (lost 3 tasks)

Per-task diff:
| task_sig | baseline | candidate | Δsecs | Δresolved | verdict | retune hint |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| find-dead-code | grep | ripgrep | -24 | +1 | candidate-wins | block grep on find-dead-code |
| refactor-auth-module | grep | lsp-symbol | -15 | 0 | candidate-wins | block grep on refactor-auth-module |
| rename-symbol-everywhere | grep | lsp-symbol | -12 | 0 | candidate-wins | block grep on rename-symbol-everywhere |

title.en: Run once with the supplied inputs

body.zh: 需要 Bun 1.1+。从新克隆的项目开始；安装依赖需要网络，后续命令读取本地示例，不启动 Agent 或请求模型 API。
body.en: Requires Bun 1.1+. Start with a fresh clone. Installation needs network access; the following commands read local examples without starting an agent or calling a model API.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/repick.git
cd repick
bun install

bun src/cli.ts record run-A --agent claude --trace examples/claude-code-trace.jsonl
bun src/cli.ts record run-B --agent codex --trace examples/codex-trace.jsonl

limitations.zh: 输入 adapter 接受本项目定义的 JSONL schema。任意原生 Agent 历史记录不保证能直接导入。
limitations.en: Input adapters accept this project’s JSONL schemas; arbitrary native agent history logs may need conversion.

limitations.zh: retune 和 gate 在 v0.1.0 中仍是占位命令。报告里的 block 是建议文字，工具可用性仍由你在外部调整。
limitations.en: retune and gate are placeholders in v0.1.0. A block hint is text advice; you still adjust tool availability outside repick.

limitations.zh: 匹配结果与指标取决于输入质量。当前报告不进行因果归因，也不证明一种工具在其他任务上更好。
limitations.en: Matching and metrics depend on the input. The report does not establish causality or prove that a tool is better on other tasks.
